blocks.text: Ingliz tilida bir qator tayyor iboralar bor, ulardan keyin fe'l doim **-ing** shaklida keladi: **there's no point in**, **it's (not) worth**, **it's no use**, **have difficulty**, **spend time**, **be busy**, **go**. Ular kundalik nutqda juda ko'p uchraydi — maslahat berish, fikr bildirish, qiyinchilik va vaqt haqida gapirishda. O'zbekchada ularga «...ning foydasi yo'q», «...ga arziydi», «...da qiynalmoq», «...ga vaqt sarflamoq» to'g'ri keladi — e'tibor bering, o'zbekchada ham fe'l «-ish» bilan otga aylanadi. Ko'pchiligida predlog bor yoki bo'lgan (→ 60-dars), shuning uchun -ing mantiqiy.
there's no point in -ing — «...ning ma'nosi yo'q»

**There's no point (in) doing** — biror ishni qilishdan foyda yo'q, u natija bermaydi. **in** ni tushirib qoldirish mumkin. Savol shaklida: **What's the point of doing ...?** (bu yerda **of**) — «...ning nima keragi bor?», ko'pincha norozilik ohangida. O'tgan zamonda: **There was no point**. Harakatni boshqa shaxs bajarsa: There's no point in **you** waiting — «Sening kutishingdan foyda yo'q». Diqqat: «**It's** no point» deyilmaydi — faqat **There's** no point.

items.text: **There's no point in arguing** with him — he never changes his mind.
items.translation: U bilan **tortishishning foydasi yo'q** — u hech qachon fikridan qaytmaydi.

items.text: **What's the point of buying** a big car if you live in the centre?
items.translation: Markazda yashasang, katta mashina **olishning nima keragi bor**?

items.text: **There was no point waiting**, so we took a taxi.
items.translation: **Kutishning ma'nosi yo'q edi**, shuning uchun taksiga o'tirdik.

blocks.text: **It's worth doing** — biror ishni qilish foydali, sarflangan vaqt yoki pulga arziydi; **It's not worth doing** — arzimaydi. Ikki xil qurilish bor: (1) **It's worth visiting** the museum; (2) The museum **is worth visiting** — ma'no bir xil, lekin ikkinchisida ega — narsaning o'zi, va gap oxiriga **it** qo'shilmaydi («The museum is worth visiting it» — xato). Fe'l predlog bilan bo'lsa, predlog oxirida qoladi: His advice **is worth listening to**. **worth** dan keyin ot ham keladi: The ring **is worth** £500; **It's worth it** — «Bunga arziydi».

items.text: The film is long, but it**'s** really **worth watching**.
**It's not worth repairing** this old printer — buy a new one.
items.translation: Bu eski printerni **ta'mirlashga arzimaydi** — yangisini oling.

items.text: **Is** Khiva **worth visiting** in summer? — Yes, but go early in the morning.
items.translation: Yozda Xivaga **borishga arziydimi**? — Ha, lekin tongda erta boring.

blocks.text: it's no use / it's no good / a waste of time

**It's no use / It's no good doing** — «...dan foyda yo'q», ko'pincha harakat qilib ko'rilgan yoki qilinmoqchi, lekin u befoyda bo'lgan holatda: It's no use **shouting** — he can't hear you. Savol shakli: **Is it any use** calling them? **(It's) a waste of time / money doing** — «...ga vaqt / pulni bekorga sarflash»: It was **a waste of money buying** that phone. Ma'nosi there's no point in ga yaqin, lekin bu iboralarda ega — **it**.

items.text: **It's no use calling** the office — everyone has gone home.
items.translation: Idoraga **qo'ng'iroq qilishdan foyda yo'q** — hamma uyiga ketib bo'lgan.

items.text: Sitting in that meeting all afternoon **was a waste of time**.
items.translation: Tushdan keyin bo'yi o'sha yig'ilishda **o'tirish vaqtni bekorga ketkazish bo'ldi**.

blocks.text: have difficulty, spend time, be busy + -ing

**have difficulty / trouble / problems (in) doing** — «...da qiynalmoq»: I **have difficulty remembering** names. **in** odatda tushib qoladi; «have difficulty to do» — xato. Sifat bilan: **no** difficulty (qiynalmasdan), **great** difficulty (katta qiyinchilik bilan). **spend / waste** + vaqt yoki pul + **-ing**: I **spent** two hours **looking** for my keys; Don't **waste** money **buying** things you don't need. **be busy doing** — «...bilan band bo'lmoq»: She**'s busy preparing** for her exams. O'zbekcha tafakkur bu yerda «uchun» qo'shishga undaydi (spend time **to** do), lekin ingliz tilida faqat -ing.

items.text: Many older people **have trouble using** online banking.
We **spent** the whole weekend **painting** the kitchen.
items.translation: Butun dam olish kunlarini oshxonani **bo'yash bilan o'tkazdik**.

items.text: Sorry, I can't talk — I**'m busy packing** for my trip.
items.translation: Kechirasiz, gaplasha olmayman — safarga **narsa yig'ish bilan bandman**.

blocks.text: **go + -ing** — asosan sport va dam olish faoliyatlari uchun (→ qizil kitob, 55-dars): **go swimming / skiing / fishing / camping / shopping / sightseeing / hiking / sailing / jogging**. Predlog yo'q: «go to swimming» — xato. Zamonda faqat **go** o'zgaradi: I **went fishing**, she**'s going shopping**. Present Perfect da **been** «borib kelgan», **gone** «hali o'sha yerda» degani: We**'ve been skiing** (qaytib keldik), They**'ve gone skiing** (hozir tog'da). Joy qo'shilsa, predlog keladi: go swimming **in** the lake, go skiing **in** Chimgan.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: (1) «It's no point to do» → **There's no point in doing**. (2) «It worths» yoki «It's worth to see» → It's **worth seeing**. (3) «The film is worth seeing it» → The film is worth **seeing** (it ortiqcha). (4) «I have difficulty to understand» → I have difficulty **understanding**. (5) «I spent two hours to fix it» → spent two hours **fixing** it. (6) «go to shopping» → **go shopping**.

Barcha iboralar uchun yagona qoida: iboradan keyin fe'l **-ing**. Shubha tug'ilsa, o'zbekcha «-ish» ni eslang: **o'qishga** arziydi — worth **reading**; **tushuntirishda** qiynaldim — had difficulty **explaining**; **kutishning** foydasi yo'q — no point (in) **waiting**.

rows: It's a waste of time **reading** that.

examples.title: **There's no point** (**in**) -ing
examples.description: There's no point (in) -ing — biror ishni qilishning foydasi, ma'nosi yo'q. Savol shakli: What's the point of -ing?

sentences.text: **There's no point in cleaning** the car if it's going to rain tomorrow.
sentences.translation: Ertaga yomg'ir yog'adigan bo'lsa, mashinani **yuvishning foydasi yo'q**.

sentences.text: Honestly, **there's no point worrying** about things you can't change.
sentences.translation: Rostini aytsam, o'zgartira olmaydigan narsalar haqida **qayg'urishning ma'nosi yo'q**.

sentences.text: **What's the point of having** a gym membership if you never go?
sentences.translation: Hech qachon bormasang, sport zaliga **a'zo bo'lishning nima keragi bor**?

sentences.text: The shop was already closed, so **there was no point in waiting**.
sentences.translation: Do'kon allaqachon yopilgan edi, shuning uchun **kutishning ma'nosi yo'q edi**.

sentences.text: Jasur thinks **there's no point studying** history, but I disagree.
sentences.translation: Jasurning fikricha, tarix **o'qishning foydasi yo'q**, lekin men bunga qo'shilmayman.

sentences.text: **Is there any point in applying** if I don't have the experience they want?
sentences.translation: Ular talab qilgan tajribam bo'lmasa, **ariza topshirishning biror foydasi bormi**?

sentences.text: **There's no point in** you **coming** to the airport — my flight lands at four in the morning.
sentences.translation: Aeroportga **kelishingning hojati yo'q** — samolyotim tungi soat to'rtda qo'nadi.

sentences.text: If nobody reads the reports, **what's the point of writing** them?
sentences.translation: Hisobotlarni hech kim o'qimasa, ularni **yozishning nima keragi bor**?

sentences.text: We realised **there was no point continuing** the meeting without the director.
sentences.translation: Direktorsiz yig'ilishni **davom ettirishning ma'nosi yo'qligini** tushundik.

sentences.text: Why argue with the referee? He won't change his decision, so **there's no point**.
sentences.translation: Hakam bilan nega tortishasan? U qarorini o'zgartirmaydi, shuning uchun **foydasi yo'q**.

examples.title: **It's (not) worth** -ing: advice and tips
examples.description: It's worth -ing — qilishga arziydi (foydali), It's not worth -ing — arzimaydi. Maslahat berishda juda ko'p ishlatiladi.

sentences.text: **It's worth booking** your train tickets at least a week in advance.
sentences.translation: Poyezd chiptalarini kamida bir hafta oldin **bron qilib qo'ygan ma'qul**.

sentences.text: **It isn't worth taking** the car — parking in the centre costs a fortune.
sentences.translation: Mashinada **borishga arzimaydi** — markazda mashina qo'yish juda qimmat.

sentences.text: If you're in Samarkand, it**'s** definitely **worth seeing** the Registan at night.
sentences.translation: Samarqandda bo'lsangiz, Registonni kechasi **ko'rishga** albatta **arziydi**.

sentences.text: **Is it worth upgrading** my laptop, or should I buy a new one?
sentences.translation: Noutbukimni **yangilashga arziydimi** yoki yangisini olganim ma'qulmi?

sentences.text: I think it**'s worth asking** the bank for a lower interest rate.
sentences.translation: Menimcha, bankdan pastroq foiz stavkasini **so'rab ko'rishga arziydi**.

sentences.text: **It wasn't worth going** to the sale — everything good had already gone.
sentences.translation: Chegirmaga **borishga arzimadi** — yaxshi narsalarning hammasi allaqachon sotilib bo'lgan ekan.

sentences.text: Although the course is expensive, it**'ll be worth it** in the long run.
sentences.translation: Kurs qimmat bo'lsa ham, uzoq muddatda **o'zini oqlaydi**.

sentences.text: Do you think it**'s worth waiting** for the next model of the phone?
sentences.translation: Telefonning keyingi modelini **kutishga arziydi**, deb o'ylaysizmi?

sentences.text: Before you choose a hotel, it **might be worth checking** the reviews.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxona tanlashdan oldin sharhlarni **ko'rib chiqqan ma'qul bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod says it**'s not worth learning** to drive in London because of the traffic.
sentences.translation: Bekzodning aytishicha, tirbandlik tufayli Londonda **haydashni o'rganishga arzimaydi**.

examples.title: Something **is worth** -ing: a book worth reading
examples.description: Ega — narsaning o'zi: The film is worth seeing. Gap oxiriga it qo'shilmaydi; worth + ot ham mumkin (worth £500, worth it).

sentences.text: This novel **is worth reading**, even if you don't usually like detective stories.
sentences.translation: Odatda detektivlarni yoqtirmasangiz ham, bu roman **o'qishga arziydi**.

sentences.text: The old town in Bukhara **is worth exploring** on foot.
sentences.translation: Buxorodagi eski shaharni piyoda **aylanib chiqishga arziydi**.

sentences.text: Their new album **isn't worth buying** — only two songs are any good.
sentences.translation: Ularning yangi albomi **sotib olishga arzimaydi** — faqat ikkita qo'shig'i durust.

sentences.text: **Is** this documentary **worth watching**, or is it boring?
sentences.translation: Bu hujjatli film **ko'rishga arziydimi** yoki zerikarlimi?

sentences.text: That old sofa **isn't worth repairing**; let's give it away.
sentences.translation: U eski divanni **ta'mirlashga arzimaydi**; birovga berib yuboraylik.

sentences.text: Oliver's advice **is** always **worth listening to**.
sentences.translation: Oliverning maslahatiga doim **quloq solishga arziydi**.

sentences.text: How much **is** your flat **worth** now that the new metro station has opened?
sentences.translation: Yangi metro bekati ochilgandan keyin kvartirangiz endi **qancha turadi**?

sentences.text: The trip was tiring and expensive, but it **was worth it**.
sentences.translation: Safar charchatadigan va qimmat bo'ldi, lekin bunga **arzidi**.

sentences.text: A good mattress **is worth** every penny if you have back problems.
sentences.translation: Belingiz og'risa, yaxshi matras har bir tiyiniga **arziydi**.

sentences.text: Which museums in London **are** really **worth visiting** with small children?
sentences.translation: Londondagi qaysi muzeylarga kichik bolalar bilan **borishga** haqiqatan **arziydi**?

examples.title: **It's no use** / **no good** / **a waste of time**
examples.description: Harakatning foydasi yo'qligi: it's no use / it's no good -ing; (it's) a waste of time / money -ing.

sentences.text: **It's no use shouting** at him — he's wearing headphones.
sentences.translation: Unga **baqirishdan foyda yo'q** — u quloqchin taqib olgan.

sentences.text: **It's no good trying** to fix the washing machine yourself; call a technician.
sentences.translation: Kir yuvish mashinasini o'zingiz **tuzatishga urinishdan foyda yo'q**; ustani chaqiring.

sentences.text: Honestly, it **would be a waste of money buying** a new car right now.
sentences.translation: Rostini aytsam, hozir yangi mashina **sotib olish pulni bekorga sarflash bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: Was the meeting useful? — No, it **was a waste of time discussing** the same problems again.
sentences.translation: Yig'ilish foydali bo'ldimi? — Yo'q, o'sha muammolarni yana **muhokama qilish vaqtni bekorga ketkazish bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: Don't pretend you're fine; it**'s no use hiding** your feelings from me.
sentences.translation: O'zingni yaxshi qilib ko'rsatma; mendan his-tuyg'ularingni **yashirishdan foyda yo'q**.

sentences.text: **It was no good asking** Tom for directions, because he didn't know the area either.
sentences.translation: Tomdan yo'l **so'rashdan foyda bo'lmadi**, chunki u ham bu atrofni bilmas ekan.

sentences.text: **Is it any use calling** the helpline on a Sunday?
sentences.translation: Yakshanba kuni ishonch telefoniga **qo'ng'iroq qilishdan biror foyda bormi**?

sentences.text: My father says it**'s a waste of time playing** video games all evening.
sentences.translation: Otamning aytishicha, kechqurun bo'yi kompyuter o'yini **o'ynash vaqtni bekorga sovurish**.

sentences.text: Since the decision has already been made, it**'s no use complaining** now.
sentences.translation: Qaror allaqachon qabul qilingan, shuning uchun endi **shikoyat qilishdan foyda yo'q**.

sentences.text: Learning words without context **is a waste of time**, according to many teachers.
sentences.translation: Ko'p o'qituvchilarning fikricha, so'zlarni kontekstsiz **yodlash vaqtni bekorga sarflashdir**.

examples.title: **have difficulty** / **have trouble** -ing
examples.description: ...da qiynalmoq: have difficulty / trouble / problems (in) -ing; no difficulty, great difficulty. To + fe'l emas!

sentences.text: Grandma **has difficulty hearing** on the phone, so please speak loudly.
sentences.translation: Buvim telefonda **eshitishda qiynaladi**, shuning uchun baland ovozda gapiring.

sentences.text: Did you **have any trouble finding** our house? — No, the map was very clear.
sentences.translation: Uyimizni **topishda qiynalmadingizmi**? — Yo'q, xarita juda aniq edi.

sentences.text: Many foreign students **have problems understanding** regional British accents.
sentences.translation: Ko'p chet ellik talabalar Britaniyaning turli shevalarini **tushunishda qiynaladi**.

sentences.text: We **had great difficulty getting** a visa for the conference.
sentences.translation: Konferensiya uchun viza **olishda katta qiyinchiliklarga duch keldik**.

sentences.text: Since the accident, Aziz **has had trouble sleeping** at night.
sentences.translation: Avtohalokatdan beri Aziz kechalari **uxlay olmay qiynalib yuribdi**.

sentences.text: Kate **had no difficulty passing** the exam because she had prepared well.
sentences.translation: Keyt yaxshi tayyorlangani uchun imtihondan **qiynalmasdan o'tdi**.

sentences.text: Are you **having trouble connecting** to the Wi-Fi? Try restarting your phone.
sentences.translation: Wi-Fi ga **ulanishda muammo bormi**? Telefoningizni o'chirib yoqib ko'ring.

sentences.text: Small businesses often **have difficulty in getting** loans from banks.
sentences.translation: Kichik bizneslar ko'pincha banklardan **kredit olishda qiynaladi**.

sentences.text: If you **have any problems using** the new system, call the IT department.
sentences.translation: Yangi tizimdan **foydalanishda biror muammo bo'lsa**, IT bo'limiga qo'ng'iroq qiling.

sentences.text: Older drivers sometimes **have trouble seeing** clearly at night.
sentences.translation: Keksa haydovchilar ba'zan tunda aniq **ko'rishda qiynaladi**.

examples.title: **spend** / **waste** time -ing and **be busy** -ing
examples.description: Vaqt va pulni nimaga sarflash: spend / waste + vaqt / pul + -ing; band bo'lish: be busy -ing.

sentences.text: Teenagers **spend** hours **scrolling** through social media every day.
sentences.translation: O'smirlar har kuni ijtimoiy tarmoqlarni **varaqlashga** soatlab **vaqt sarflaydi**.

sentences.text: I **spent** the whole morning **trying** to get through to the tax office.
sentences.translation: Butun tongni soliq idorasiga telefon orqali **bog'lanishga urinib o'tkazdim**.

sentences.text: Don't **waste** your money **buying** souvenirs at the airport — they're cheaper in town.
sentences.translation: Aeroportda esdalik sovg'alari **sotib olib**, pulingizni **bekorga sarflamang** — shaharda arzonroq.

sentences.text: Madina **is busy preparing** for her final exams, so she can't come.
sentences.translation: Madina bitiruv imtihonlariga **tayyorlanish bilan band**, shuning uchun kela olmaydi.

sentences.text: How much time do you **spend commuting** every week?
sentences.translation: Har hafta ishga **qatnashga** qancha **vaqt sarflaysiz**?

sentences.text: We **wasted** half the holiday **waiting** for our lost luggage.
sentences.translation: Ta'tilning yarmini yo'qolgan yukimizni **kutish bilan behuda o'tkazdik**.

sentences.text: When I called, Tom **was busy fixing** his bike in the garage.
sentences.translation: Men qo'ng'iroq qilganimda Tom garajda velosipedini **tuzatish bilan band edi**.

sentences.text: Last year the city **spent** millions **repairing** roads in the centre.
sentences.translation: O'tgan yili shahar markazdagi yo'llarni **ta'mirlashga** millionlab pul **sarfladi**.

sentences.text: Stop **wasting** time **checking** your emails and start writing the report!
sentences.translation: Pochtangizni **tekshirib vaqtni bekorga ketkazishni** bas qiling va hisobotni yozishni boshlang!

sentences.text: My parents **are** always **busy doing** something in the garden at the weekend.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam dam olish kunlari doim bog'da biror narsa **qilish bilan band**.

examples.title: **go** -ing: go skiing, go shopping, go camping
examples.description: Sport va dam olish faoliyatlari: go + -ing (predlogsiz). Zamonda faqat go o'zgaradi: went fishing, have been sailing.

sentences.text: In winter we often **go skiing** in Chimgan with our friends.
sentences.translation: Qishda do'stlarimiz bilan Chimyonga tez-tez **chang'i uchgani boramiz**.

sentences.text: Emma **went shopping** in Oxford Street and spent all her salary.
sentences.translation: Emma Oksford-stritga **xarid qilgani bordi** va butun maoshini sarfladi.

sentences.text: **Have** you ever **been fishing** at the Charvak reservoir?
sentences.translation: Chorvoq suv omborida hech **baliq oviga borganmisiz**?

sentences.text: Let's **go swimming** before it gets too hot.
sentences.translation: Havo juda isib ketmasdan **suzishga boraylik**.

sentences.text: Every autumn my uncle **goes hiking** in the mountains near Fergana.
sentences.translation: Amakim har kuzda Farg'ona yaqinidagi tog'larga **piyoda sayrga chiqadi**.

sentences.text: **Are** you **going jogging** this evening, or is it too cold?
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun **yugurishga chiqasizmi** yoki havo juda sovuqmi?

sentences.text: On our first day in London, we **went sightseeing** on a red bus.
sentences.translation: Londondagi birinchi kunimizda qizil avtobusda **shaharni tomosha qilgani chiqdik**.

sentences.text: James **hasn't been sailing** since he moved away from the coast.
sentences.translation: Jeyms qirg'oqdan uzoqqa ko'chib ketganidan beri **yelkanli qayiqda suzmagan**.

sentences.text: The children want to **go camping** by the lake during the summer holidays.
sentences.translation: Bolalar yozgi ta'tilda ko'l bo'yiga **chodir tikib dam olgani borishni** xohlashadi.

sentences.text: Why don't we **go cycling** along the river on Sunday instead of watching TV?
sentences.translation: Yakshanba kuni televizor ko'rish o'rniga daryo bo'yida **velosipedda sayr qilsak-chi**?

examples.title: Dialogue: a weekend in the mountains?
examples.description: Suhbat: ikki do'st dam olish rejasi haqida bahslashadi — worth, no point, no use, spend time, busy va go -ing bir joyda.

sentences.text: — Are you **going skiing** with us on Saturday, Aziz?
sentences.translation: — Shanba kuni biz bilan **chang'i uchgani borasanmi**, Aziz?

sentences.text: — I'd love to, but it**'s not worth driving** to the mountains for one day.
sentences.translation: — Borardim-u, lekin bir kun uchun tog'ga mashinada **borishga arzimaydi**.

sentences.text: — Why not? **There's no point in staying** at home all weekend.
sentences.translation: — Nega? Dam olish kunlari bo'yi uyda **o'tirishning ma'nosi yo'q**.

sentences.text: — I know, but I **spent** last Saturday **sitting** in traffic on that road.
sentences.translation: — Bilaman, lekin o'tgan shanbani o'sha yo'lda tirbandlikda **o'tirib o'tkazdim**.

sentences.text: — This time we're leaving at six, so we won't **have any trouble getting** there.
sentences.translation: — Bu safar soat oltida chiqamiz, shuning uchun u yerga **yetib olishda qiynalmaymiz**.

sentences.text: — Six? It**'s no use asking** me to get up that early at the weekend!
sentences.translation: — Oltida? Dam olish kuni meni bunchalik erta turishga **undashdan foyda yo'q**!

sentences.text: — Come on, the snow is perfect now, and the views **are worth seeing**.
sentences.translation: — Qo'ysang-chi, qor hozir zo'r, manzaralar esa **ko'rishga arziydi**.

sentences.text: — Maybe, but I**'m busy finishing** a project, and the deadline is Monday.
sentences.translation: — Balki, lekin men loyihani **tugatish bilan bandman**, muddati esa dushanba.

sentences.text: — Then work tonight! It would be **a waste of** a sunny weekend **staying** indoors.
sentences.translation: — Unda bugun kechqurun ishla! Quyoshli dam olish kunini uyda **o'tirib behuda o'tkazish** achinarli bo'lardi.

sentences.text: — All right, you win — but **what's the point of going** if I can't ski well?
sentences.translation: — Mayli, yutding — lekin yaxshi chang'i ucha olmasam, **borishning nima keragi bor**?
